_hosts_comment: Hostnames or addresses passed to ping; every target is measured independently. Anything ping accepts works - "1.1.1.1", "db1.internal", "example.com" - and a name that does not resolve shows as DOWN rather than being dropped, so a typo is visible instead of silent.
_interval_comment: Seconds between ping samples per target.
_seconds_per_column_comment: Seconds represented by one graph column; 0 chooses from the pane width and retained window.
_window_comment: Seconds of readings retained for statistics and graphs.
_spike_factor_comment: How many times above the recent baseline marks a latency spike.
_aggregate_comment: How several samples in one graph column are combined.
_strip_suffixes_comment: Hostname suffixes removed from on-screen labels only - the target is still pinged by its full name. Give the leading dot: ".internal" turns db1.internal into db1, and ".eu-west-1.compute.internal" turns a long cloud name into the host part. Longest match wins, so a general suffix and a more specific one can both be listed.
